proposed_comments.title: Return the full-width native window handle

confidence.rationale: MainWindow initializes _hwnd through ToInt32, while GetHwndMessage.Hwnd is pointer-sized. Returning the raw WinUI handle avoids deterministic 64-bit narrowing; the corrected fork implementation builds and passes all targeted tests.

proposed_comments.body:
### Return the full-width native window handle

**Severity:** `high`

The cached `_hwnd` is initialized through `ToInt32()`, so returning it here can truncate a 64-bit window handle before consumers use it. That can make HWND-dependent commands target an invalid window. Return the raw WinUI handle so the pointer-sized value is preserved end to end.

```suggestion
        message.Hwnd = this.GetWindowHandle();
```

> If applying both suggestions in this file individually, apply this later-line suggestion first, or batch both suggestions and commit them atomically.

proposed_comments.title: Use an explicit scheduler for the delayed focus continuation

confidence.rationale: ContinueWith otherwise captures TaskScheduler.Current from the caller context. The explicit default-scheduler version compiled in the full CmdPal UI build and preserves the intended dispatcher hop through RunOnUiThread.

proposed_comments.body:
### Use an explicit scheduler for the delayed focus continuation

**Severity:** `medium`

This fire-and-forget continuation inherits `TaskScheduler.Current`, so its execution context can vary with the message-delivery caller. Explicitly selecting the default scheduler keeps the delay off any ambient scheduler, while `RunOnUiThread` remains the single controlled hop back to the dispatcher.

```suggestion
            _ = Task.Delay(200).ContinueWith(
                _ => RunOnUiThread(StealForeground),
                CancellationToken.None,
                TaskContinuationOptions.None,
                TaskScheduler.Default);
```

> If applying both suggestions in this file individually, apply the later-line HWND suggestion first, or batch both suggestions and commit them atomically.

proposed_comments.title: Name the message for every session action it counts

confidence.rationale: ShellViewModel sends this message for both accepted command invocations and page navigation, and its XML summary already documents both cases. The coordinated TelemetrySessionActionStartedMessage rename builds and all 376 tests pass.

proposed_comments.body:
### Name the message for every session action it counts

**Severity:** `low`

`TelemetryCommandStartedMessage` is sent for both command invocations and page navigation, so the command-only name conflicts with the behavior documented by the type itself. Please rename the file and record to `TelemetrySessionActionStartedMessage`, then update the registrations, sends, receiver, and tests together so future callers do not assume it is command-specific.
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: The safe change requires an atomic file rename plus coordinated updates across MainWindow, ShellViewModel, and the test file; GitHub cannot express that multi-file rename as one apply-ready current-diff suggestion.
